name: Gemcitabine + Docetaxel for Uterine Leiomyosarcoma

biomarkers.note: The gemcitabine plus docetaxel doublet is a cytotoxic backbone for uterine leiomyosarcoma and is not biomarker restricted. Per Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Uterine Neoplasms v3.2026, Systemic Therapy for Uterine Sarcoma (UTSARC-C).

lineOfTherapy: traditional first line combination for advanced, metastatic, or recurrent uterine leiomyosarcoma

eligibilityCriteria.requirement: advanced, metastatic, or recurrent uterine leiomyosarcoma
eligibilityCriteria.locator: v3.2026, Systemic Therapy for Uterine Sarcoma, Docetaxel/Gemcitabine (UTSARC-C)

drugs.name: Gemcitabine

provenance.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.
provenance.locator: line 176028 (Gemcitabine 900 mg/m2 over 90 min on days 1 and 8 + docetaxel 100 mg/m2 on day 8 with G-CSF q 21 d, Hensley et al.); narrative line 175829

drugs.notes: Source: DeVita 12th ed., line 176028 (Hensley regimen) and narrative line 175829. Gemcitabine 900 mg/m2 IV over 90 minutes on days 1 and 8, every 21 days, with growth factor support.

drugs.name: DOCEtaxel

provenance.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.
provenance.locator: line 176031 (docetaxel 100 mg/m2 on day 8 with G-CSF q 21 d, Hensley et al.); reduced dose alternative line 175835 (docetaxel 75 mg/m2)

drugs.notes: Source: DeVita 12th ed., line 176031 (Hensley regimen). DOCEtaxel 100 mg/m2 IV on day 8, every 21 days, with growth factor support. Source stated alternative: DOCEtaxel reduced to 75 mg/m2 (line 175835), with further reductions for patients with prior pelvic radiotherapy. Requires corticosteroid premedication per docetaxel labeling. Tall man per ISMP.

regimen.cycles: the Hensley gemcitabine/docetaxel regimen does not print a fixed cycle count; continue per response and tolerance, physician determined (the 6-cycle figure in the GeDDiS trial used a lower gemcitabine dose)

premedications.name: DOCEtaxel premedication
premedications.notes: corticosteroid premedication per docetaxel labeling to reduce fluid retention and hypersensitivity.

supportiveCare: G-CSF / myeloid growth factor support is required for this doublet per the source (DeVita line 176028, with G-CSF).
monitor for the occasional severe pulmonary toxicity noted with this combination (DeVita line 175823).

monitoring: pulmonary symptom assessment (rare severe pulmonary toxicity)
fluid retention / edema assessment for DOCEtaxel

doseModificationRules.text: Dose reductions of both drugs for patients with prior pelvic radiotherapy per the source (DeVita line 175835).

doseModificationRules.condition: ANC < 1500 or platelets < 100k on day 1 or day 8
doseModificationRules.text: Hold or delay per institutional protocol; physician decides.

core.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.
core.locator: lines 176028 to 176031 (Gemcitabine 900 mg/m2 over 90 min days 1 and 8 + docetaxel 100 mg/m2 day 8 with G-CSF q 21 d, Hensley et al.); narrative lines 175823 to 175842 (traditional front line regimen; reduced docetaxel 75 mg/m2 alternative at 175835)

guideline.locator: Systemic Therapy for Uterine Sarcoma, Docetaxel/Gemcitabine (UTSARC-C 1 of 3)

divergence.note: The same DeVita source reports the original Hensley docetaxel dose of 100 mg/m2 on day 8 and a later reduced dose of 75 mg/m2 used in subsequent trials, with further reductions for prior pelvic radiotherapy. Authored value kept at 100 mg/m2 (original); 75 mg/m2 is a documented alternative. Selection left to clinical review.

provenanceNote: ONCQIS Standard Protocol draft for gemcitabine plus docetaxel in uterine leiomyosarcoma (StewardMD reference disease leiomyosarcoma, uterine sarcoma subtype group #51). Doses are grounded to DeVita 12th ed. lines 176028 to 176031 (Hensley regimen: Gemcitabine 900 mg/m2 IV over 90 minutes on days 1 and 8 plus DOCEtaxel 100 mg/m2 on day 8, with G-CSF, every 21 days); the narrative at lines 175823 to 175842 identifies this as the traditional front line uLMS regimen and records a reduced docetaxel dose of 75 mg/m2 in later trials (line 175835), captured as a divergence. Regimen identity is cross referenced to Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Uterine Neoplasms v3.2026, Systemic Therapy for Uterine Sarcoma (UTSARC-C), which lists Docetaxel/Gemcitabine without printing the mg. G-CSF support is source required. ISMP tall man applied (DOCEtaxel). No field is set to VERIFY. This remains a StewardMD Standard Protocol; no endorsement implied.
